description: One memory for every AI tool on your team. Facts show who checked them and when.

plugins.name: koalafix
plugins.description: Shared team memory and work items for Claude Code and the other AI tools your team uses.

plugins.name: koalafix-auto
plugins.description: Makes KoalaFix automatic in Claude Code and Cowork: the team brief at session start, recall on each prompt, work started and closed for you. In Claude Code it installs the koalafix plugin with it; on claude.ai and in Cowork, add koalafix too. Needs Node.js 22 or later.
